parameters.max_route_duration: <float> Maximum allowed duration for any single route, including all travel, service, and handling times.
parameters.service_time: <float> Time spent at each customer location to perform the collection service.
parameters.coupling_time: <float> Time required to reattach a trailer to the truck at a parking location.
parameters.decoupling_time: <float> Time required to detach the trailer from the truck at a parking location.
parameters.transfer_time: <float> Time required to transfer load from the truck to the parked trailer at a parking location.
parameters.coupling_cost: <float> Cost incurred each time a trailer is reattached to the truck.
parameters.decoupling_cost: <float> Cost incurred each time a trailer is detached from the truck.
parameters.transfer_cost: <float> Cost incurred each time load is transferred from the truck to the trailer at a parking location.
parameters.planning_horizon: <list[float], length 2> Earliest and latest times defining the time window within which all routes must start and finish.

truck_types.id: <int> Unique identifier for this truck type.
truck_types.capacity: <int> Maximum load the truck can carry.
truck_types.fixed_cost: <float> Cost incurred whenever a truck of this type is deployed on a route.
truck_types.cost_factor: <float> Multiplier applied to travel distance to compute the truck's distance-based travel cost.
truck_types.num_available: <int> Number of trucks of this type available in the fleet.

trailer_types.id: <int> Unique identifier for this trailer type.
trailer_types.capacity: <int> Maximum load the trailer can carry.
trailer_types.towing_cost_multiplier: <float> Additional multiplier applied to travel distance when this trailer is attached to a truck.
trailer_types.num_available: <int> Number of trailers of this type available in the fleet.

vehicle_classes.class_id: <int> Unique identifier for this vehicle class.
vehicle_classes.truck_type_id: <int> Identifier of the truck type used in this class.
vehicle_classes.trailer_type_id: <int> Identifier of the trailer type paired with the truck, or 0 if the truck operates solo.
vehicle_classes.truck_capacity: <int> Load capacity of the truck in this class.
vehicle_classes.trailer_capacity: <int> Load capacity of the trailer in this class, or 0 if no trailer.
vehicle_classes.total_capacity: <int> Combined load capacity of the truck and trailer in this class.
vehicle_classes.truck_fixed_cost: <float> Fixed cost for deploying the truck in this class.
vehicle_classes.truck_cost_factor: <float> Distance-based cost multiplier for the truck in this class.
vehicle_classes.trailer_towing_cost_multiplier: <float> Additional distance-based cost multiplier when the trailer is attached, or 0 if no trailer.
vehicle_classes.num_available: <int> Number of vehicles of this class available for deployment.
vehicle_classes.description: <str> Human-readable label describing the truck and trailer pairing.

truck_customers.id: <int> Unique identifier for this truck customer.
truck_customers.supply: <int> Quantity of goods to be collected from this customer.
truck_customers.service_time: <float> Time spent at this customer to perform collection.

trailer_customers.id: <int> Unique identifier for this trailer customer.
trailer_customers.supply: <int> Quantity of goods to be collected from this customer.
trailer_customers.service_time: <float> Time spent at this customer to perform collection.

transshipment_locations.id: <int> Unique identifier for this transshipment location.
transshipment_locations.x: <float> Horizontal coordinate of this transshipment location.
transshipment_locations.y: <float> Vertical coordinate of this transshipment location.

distance_matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [num_locations][num_locations]> Travel distance between each pair of locations, indexed by location identifier.
travel_time_matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [num_locations][num_locations]> Travel time between each pair of locations, indexed by location identifier.
